name: money-tabs
description: Money Tabs - one React app packaged as a Windows desktop app and an Android APK, sharing a hosted Turso database.

scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:web && cd desktop && npm run build
scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && cd mobile && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:web && cd desktop && npm run build && cd ../mobile && npm run build
